mainEntity.name: What should I track to know whether my AI affiliate workflow is working?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Track the journey from content exposure to qualified click, opt-in, affiliate click, conversion, refund, and commission. AI can consolidate reports and identify patterns, but it cannot repair missing tracking or distinguish causation from coincidence by itself.

**Context:** Run My AI Biz includes reporting, coordination, and recurring operational workflows. Those workflows depend on accurate inputs from affiliate dashboards, email systems, analytics, and link tracking.

**Key factors:**
- Consistent campaign and link identifiers
- Attribution windows and delayed reporting
- Refunds, cancellations, and commission reversals
- Separation of organic, email, and paid traffic

**Practical guidance:** Create one simple reporting sheet before publishing, test every link, and reconcile affiliate reports with your own records. Avoid declaring a winner from a small or incomplete data set.

The business’s operational emphasis supports repeatable measurement rather than guesswork.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track qualified visits, opt-ins, affiliate clicks, conversions, refunds, and commissions by channel and campaign. Use consistent link identifiers, test tracking before launch, and reconcile affiliate reports with your own records.
